Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Front-End Application Developer position at prado. With a background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and a strong technical foundation in web technologies, I am excited about the opportunity to build intuitive interfaces for your smart home ecosystem.

In my recent role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in building and maintaining WordPress sites, implementing structured data, and optimizing for performance and user experience. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to design and develop responsive, multi-page websites with a focus on SEO and AI-driven search visibility.

I am eager to apply my front-end skills to mobile and cross-platform development, and I am particularly interested in the integration of applications with cloud backends and IoT environments. I am a quick learner, comfortable with modern frameworks, and committed to code quality and performance.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and enthusiasm align with prado's vision. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Front-End Application Developer position at prado. As a developer with a solid foundation in front-end technologies and a passion for creating seamless user experiences, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your next-generation smart home ecosystem.

In my previous role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This experience taught me the importance of clean, maintainable code and the value of collaborating closely with design and back-end teams to deliver reliable, user-friendly interfaces.

More recently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress, implementing on-page SEO, and tracking performance with analytics tools. While this role has a marketing focus, it has strengthened my technical skills in web development, structured data (JSON-LD), and performance optimization. My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to design and build a responsive multi-page site from scratch, integrating social media and implementing technical SEO/GEO improvements.

I am particularly drawn to prado's mission of creating invisible home technology for architects. The idea of building interfaces that allow users to control their entire home environment—across mobile, web, and desktop—is both challenging and inspiring. I am eager to expand my skills into cross-platform development with frameworks like React Native or Flutter, and I have a strong interest in AI applications and IoT integration.

I am a quick learner, dedicated to code quality and performance, and I thrive in collaborative environments. I am confident that my technical background, combined with my enthusiasm for smart home technology, makes me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to prado's growth.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
